summary: Shared base of the field scene-object hierarchy (vtable 0x0075BF34, base dtor 0x00335DAC): world position, intrusive child list, inline child array, scene draw entry and the placement block copied from the map descriptor. NOTE: the batch groups every function whose name starts with Field_Object_, and several of them (Field_Object_SetMode/OnEvent/BindModelTransform*) receive an interior pointer (self-0x258, self-0x1330), so a few offsets below come from a different self base and are marked unknown.
evidence: Field_Object_DtorBase (0x00335DAC) installs vtable 0x00764A38 and walks the child list at 0x1F8/0x1FC/0x200; Field_Object_ActivateChildren uses the inline child array at 0x204 with count 0x224; Field_Object_GetWorldPosition copies 0x9C/0xA0/0xA4; Field_Object_InitFromDescriptor (0x004D7154) fills 0x3C..0xA0 from a map descriptor and the kind-0 record; size 4716 = highest strong field 0x1268 + 4.
